title: BensItemHunter
description: Best Item Hunter Plugin on the Market
body:
# Ben's Item Hunt
ItemHunter is a challenge for your Minecraft server: Start a collective hunt where players must gradually collect every possible item, defeat all mobs, and complete every advancement/achievement – featuring a live timer and real-time progress tracking.

![Item Hunt Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4fd5594ff8309bd0be5100bd3692cb2cfe15b8d.png)

## Features:

* **Combined Challenge**: Find items + kill mobs + complete advancements (all contributing to a total progress score).
* **In-game UI**: Visual overview via GUI (item/challenge views) and status displays.
* **Timer System**: Integrated timer with Pause/Resume (automatically pauses when no players are online).
* **Live Displays**: ActionBar timer, BossBar progress, and optional Tablist including TPS/Ping + progress.
* **Highly Configurable**: Toggle item categories, exclude specific items, and customize sounds or prefixes.
* **Admin Commands**: Comprehensive control via `/itemhunt` (Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Status, Items, Reset, Skip).
* **Folia Support**: Compatible with Folia, Paper, and Bukkit.
